case_studies.title: Feedback intelligence agent
case_studies.problem: Turn unstructured customer feedback into traceable, queryable evidence.
case_studies.constraints: Ground answers in retrieved evidence, measure retrieval quality, expose latency/cost and support production serving.
case_studies.method: RAG pipeline with FastAPI, evaluation, observability and CI.
case_studies.outcome: A production-style feedback intelligence system whose answer quality can be tested rather than asserted.

case_studies.title: Qwen text-to-SQL adaptation
case_studies.problem: Determine whether parameter-efficient fine-tuning actually improves text-to-SQL execution.
case_studies.constraints: Avoid string-match evaluation, control data volume and adapter capacity, and compare against the untouched base model.
case_studies.method: Controlled LoRA/QLoRA experiments scored by execution accuracy against the target database.
case_studies.outcome: A falsifiable model-adaptation study showing where fine-tuning earns its cost.

case_studies.title: Clinic forecasting platform
case_studies.problem: Forecast healthcare demand while supporting staffing decisions under uncertainty.
case_studies.constraints: Temporal leakage, multiple forecasting families, uncertainty intervals and production monitoring.
case_studies.method: Rolling-origin benchmark across thirteen models with conformal intervals and serving.
case_studies.outcome: A full forecast-to-operation workflow rather than a single accuracy leaderboard.

case_studies.title: Transaction risk lakehouse
case_studies.problem: Build a reproducible risk/fraud modelling pipeline on transaction data.
case_studies.constraints: Large-scale processing, temporal validation and separation between data-engineering and modelling concerns.
case_studies.method: PySpark lakehouse with temporal model evaluation and production-style data contracts.
case_studies.outcome: An end-to-end risk platform where model evidence is tied to the data pipeline that produced it.

case_studies.title: FNO versus persistence on NOAA OISST
case_studies.problem: Test whether an FNO materially improves seven-day SST field forecasts over persistence.
case_studies.constraints: Real NOAA data, spatial scale dependence and the need for a strong trivial baseline.
case_studies.method: Controlled operator-learning experiment with spatial-scale diagnostics.
case_studies.outcome: A falsifiable scientific-ML comparison centred on where the complex model actually earns its place.

case_studies.title: Energy-system dispatch
case_studies.problem: Choose feasible electricity dispatch under intertemporal physical and economic constraints.
case_studies.constraints: Unit commitment, ramping, minimum up/down time, storage, hydro, imports and demand response.
case_studies.method: Explicit optimisation rather than a learned surrogate.
case_studies.outcome: A decision system that produces operational schedules and exposes the constraints driving them.

case_studies.title: Perishable inventory replenishment
case_studies.problem: Convert uncertain demand forecasts into replenishment decisions for perishable goods.
case_studies.constraints: Censoring, spoilage, leakage-safe forecasting and asymmetric inventory costs.
case_studies.method: Calibrated probabilistic forecasting coupled to inventory simulation and policy comparison.
case_studies.outcome: Forecast quality is judged through the downstream replenishment policy rather than forecast error alone.

case_studies.title: Scania APS maintenance decisions
case_studies.problem: Detect costly truck failures without optimising the wrong classification metric.
case_studies.constraints: Extreme class imbalance and a 10×FP + 500×FN maintenance-cost structure.
case_studies.method: Calibration, imbalance handling, representation learning and threshold selection against explicit cost.
case_studies.outcome: Model selection becomes an operating-cost decision rather than an accuracy contest.

case_studies.title: Probabilistic taxi fleet allocation
case_studies.problem: Allocate a finite taxi fleet spatially under uncertain hourly demand.
case_studies.constraints: Real geography, fleet conservation, policy-dependent state propagation and trip-duration availability.
case_studies.method: Probabilistic count forecasting feeding constrained allocation and rolling fleet-state simulation.
case_studies.outcome: Forecasts are evaluated by service level, regret and operating cost, exposing when better uncertainty modelling does not imply a better decision policy.

case_studies.title: Portuguese public pension financing
case_studies.problem: Determine how Portugal's public pension promise was financed across institutional regimes.
case_studies.constraints: Legal changes, accounting consolidation, transfers, actuarial liabilities and historical comparability.
case_studies.method: Auditable legal/accounting data model with explicit measurement boundaries.
case_studies.outcome: A research framework where definitions and provenance are part of the estimand rather than preprocessing details.

case_studies.title: Portugal general-government balance
case_studies.problem: Measure how the general-government balance is formed across institutional subsectors over time.
case_studies.constraints: Changing statistical definitions, intra-government transfers and long historical coverage.
case_studies.method: Subsector accounting reconstruction with explicit consolidation rules and source provenance.
case_studies.outcome: A reproducible decomposition of the balance without inferring political intent from accounting aggregates.

case_studies.title: Minimum wage and price pass-through
case_studies.problem: Estimate how minimum-wage changes interact with productivity and consumer prices in Portugal.
case_studies.constraints: Long-run structural change, regional/industry exposure and the Madeira/Azores differentiation.
case_studies.method: Growth accounting plus exposure-based pass-through designs.
case_studies.outcome: A research design that separates national co-movement from heterogeneous exposure to policy changes.

case_studies.title: GDP–wage transmission
case_studies.problem: Estimate how growth and productivity transmit into real wages and whether that relationship changes.
case_studies.constraints: Non-stationarity, measurement mismatch, structural breaks and time-varying transmission.
case_studies.method: ECM, state-space modelling, break analysis and cross-country robustness checks.
case_studies.outcome: A layered estimate of long-run and evolving wage transmission rather than a single correlation.
